product_one_liner.value: Trusaic provides pay-equity analytics, pay-transparency and regulatory-compliance software for employers and their HR, compensation and legal teams.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing navigation or plan page found; the site directs buyers to contact sales or request a demo.

founded_year.notes: The company profile reports 1999; some third-party directories instead report 2014.

eng_blog.notes: The index is regulatory, product and thought-leadership content; no qualifying series of engineer-authored implementation posts was found.

public_docs.notes: No public product-documentation or help-center link was found in the site navigation/footer; the resources library contains educational and marketing materials.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page exists, but its job inventory is not readable. The Data Scientist I listing found elsewhere explicitly says expired, so it cannot establish a current opening or an exhaustive negative.

model_provider.notes: No underlying model or AI provider is publicly named in the checked AI FAQ, responsible-AI pages, blog, Trust Center or data-processing/subprocessor disclosures. Azure is listed as infrastructure, not an AI-model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 are certification/audit claims; GDPR is a compliance claim, not a standalone certification.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn reports no funding rounds; the founder says the company is employee/founder-owned, debt-free and has taken no outside funding.

raised_18mo.notes: No outside funding identified; the funding profile reports no rounds.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live third-party listings advertise Global Enterprise Account Executive and Sales Development Representative positions; the official careers page does not expose its job inventory.

launched_6mo.notes: May 20, 2026: introduced an enhanced EU Pay Transparency Directive Monitor with an interactive map and country-specific tracking, within the requested window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small leadership roster and available profiles were checked. The recent VP/EVP starts identified were August and September 2025, before the window; no qualifying C-level/VP join or departure was found. The March 2026 adviser appointment is not C-level or VP-level.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The account-executive job description explicitly names these systems for managing and forecasting pipeline.
